expectations.text: The supplied SSRN preprint is distinguished from the unverified journal version, and the pilot note is not treated as a complete packet.
expectations.evidence: It distinguishes the SSRN preprint from the final journal version and calls the page pilot-only/incomplete.

expectations.text: The report identifies nonqualifying same-context review and missing source/manifest/visual or supplement evidence, routes BLOCKED, and withholds READY_FOR_DOWNSTREAM.
expectations.evidence: It notes missing PDF, Markdown, manifest, figures, supplements, and independence, and routes BLOCKED with no downstream qualification.

expectations.text: The report does not invent Paper map, Experimental Records, or active Findings; it records their absence and keeps affected coverage unresolved.
expectations.evidence: It reports that no Paper map, structured Records, or active Findings were supplied and does not fabricate records.

expectations.text: The report uses the exact six active ledger dimension names with valid states and does not write to or alter Notion/source content.
expectations.evidence: It uses provisional noncanonical dimension labels and states including BLOCKED and NEEDS_REVIEW rather than the six active ledger fields and valid dimension enum.

suggestions.reason: Separate the objective ledger-schema assertion from the no-write side effect. The latter needs readback or a run transcript, while the dimension enum can be verified directly from the report.

eval_feedback.overall: The first three assertions test meaningful real-source limitations. Split the schema and side-effect checks so each has direct evidence.
